name: twinny-server
description: Serve your local models to the Twinny VS Code extension on other machines.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;if(!fs.existsSync('cli.js')){console.error('Run npm run build in the repository root first');process.exit(1)}if(!fs.readFileSync('cli.js','utf8').includes('\"'+v+'\" : \"dev\"')){console.error('cli.js was not built for '+v+': run npm run build in the repository root first');process.exit(1)}"
